correctness.rationale: The proof verifies the exact four-path face criterion and a complete, injective owner-pivot matching. Any non-backtracking downward move from a matched upper retains the owner pivot and cannot be another matched lower, proving acyclicity. The two-dimensional CW model is simply connected by the original full two-skeleton; Hurewicz/Whitehead establishes a two-sphere wedge. Critical-triangle counts give B for all part sizes. The standalone checker passed 14 exhaustive instances including non-shellable K_(3,3,3), but finite checks alone are not used as proof.
